newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Citibank to issue A$150 mln off funding programme.
newsitem.headline: Citibank to issue A$150 mln off funding programme.

text.p: Citibank Ltd said on Wednesday it is issuing A$150 million in transferable certificates of deposit next week off its A$500 million funding programme.
The issue, which will carry a 7.0 percent coupon and mature March 15, 2002, would be priced on Monday, June 16.
The arranger and lead manager is Citisecurities and dealers would be Westpac and Commonwealth Bank of Australia.
This would be the first issue off the programme which was first announced in March.
Earlier, Standard & Poor's rated the funding programme AA minus based on Citibank's ultimate ownership by, and integration with, the U.S.-based Citicorp group.
